text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

Australia, Aug 26 - COAL - Queensland, Abbot Point - berth vacant, 4 vessels due by 19/9, no delays. Dalrymple Bay - two vessels loading, 6 waiting, 11 vessels due by 15/9, approx 4-5 days delay expected. Hay Point - one vessel loading, 6 waiting 5 vessels due. Approx 5-6 days delay expected. Gladstone - R.G. Tanna, 2 vessels loading, 2 waiting, 26 vessels due by 25/9. Approx 1-2 days delay. Barney Point major shutdown to upgrade terminals, plant and equipment 5/8-25/10. No shiploading and train unloading operations will be performed. Brisbane - MUA unions stopwork meeting from 0800-1130 27/8. One vessel loading, 1 waiting 5 vessels due by 14/9 approx. 1 Days delay expected.

New South Wales - Newcastle dykes 4+5 - 2 vessels loading, 9 waiting, 9 vessels due by 7/9. Approx 9-10 days delay expected Kooragang 2 vessels loading, 9 waiting, 10 vessels due by 5/9, approx 1 days delay expected.

Iron ore, Western Australia - Port Hedland - BHP Iron ore pty, Mt. Newman (Nelson Point), A berth 1 vessel loading, 1 waiting 5 vessels due by 1/9. B berth 1 vessel loading, 5 due by 3/9, 3 other vessels due, no eta received. BHP iron ore - Goldsworthy (Finucane Island) 1 vessel loading, 1 anchored. Dampier - Parker Point scheduled maintenance shutdown 0900 27/8 to 0900 28/8. 1 vessel loading, 3 waiting, 1 vessel due 26/8. East Intercourse Island 1 vessel loading, 2 due 11/9. Dampier line-up 15 vessels due by 9/9 of which 11 for Parker Point, 4 for East Intercourse Island. Port Walcott - one vessel loading, 2 anchored 5 vessels due by 3/9.
Aug 28 - GRAIN - Queensland, Mackay - no vessels due. Gladstone - no vessels due. Brisbane - one vessel loading sorghum, 1 wheat vessel due 5/9.

New South Wales, Newcastle - five wheat vessels due by 10/9. Port Kembla - three wheat vessels due by 8/9, 5 due in October. Victoria - Geelong - three wheat vessels due by 10/9. Portland - one peas vessel in port, 2 vessels due by 23/9.

South Australia, Port Pirie - two wheat vessels due by 9/9. Port Adelaide - one vessel loading oats, 1 wheat vessel in port, 5 vessels due by 15/9. Authorised MUA stopwork meeting on 28/8 from 0800 to 1200. Thevenard, Port Lincoln, Wallaroo, Ardrossan - no vessels due. Port Giles - one vessel loading barley.

Western Australia - Geraldton - three wheat vessels due by 6/9. Kwinana - one vessel loading wheat, 5 wheat vessels due by 8/9. Dispute between Co-operative Bulk Handling (CBH) and maintenance workers continues, restricted working to a single shift per day. Single shift has now been going on for more than a month. Albany - three wheat vessels due by 2/9. Esperance - one barley vessel due 31/8.
